schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (60 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side prints label 26 twice (match q026, one-mark q026b); 62 questions. Answer side 1-25, [match block, unnumbered], 26-60 (key 26 restates q026b); q061 (draw) no key. Difficulty per question: easy 41, average 12, difficult 9, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 64 (heading, LO) 65-68; A pdf 163 (heading, keys 1-20) 164-167.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following with correct answers (EASY)' q026; s5 one mark q026b-q035 vsa; s6 two marks q36-45 sa; s7 three marks q46-55 sa; s8 four marks q56-61 la.

NUMBERING: label 26 printed twice (pdf 66 match, pdf 67 'What is transportation?') -> q026, q026b (v1.4 §14.1). The answer side's match block carries no number and its one-mark run opens '26. What is transportation?' — the same printed label and the restated stem of q026b -> paired by printed label; no band.

KEY FORM: fill keys print the completed sentence (verbatim; q15's line carried the T/F heading in the text layer, removed). Keys 26-60 restate (or paraphrase) the question on the number line; the answer follows (restated()). Bullet keys one step per bullet; a lead line ending ':' a heading; q59's closing un-bulleted line 'They help us go from place to place.' its own step.
Tags without '(' read (q47 '?.Easy)'). q61 draw -> 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_15.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
